title: Frobenius orbit codes and finite-field Fourier spectra: exact distance and coset distributions
summary: Let $q$ be a prime power, let $m\ge1$, put $Q=q^m$, and let a permutation $π$ of a finite index set $I$ satisfy $π^m=1$. We study the $\F q$-linear code \[ \mathcal C(π)=\{x\in\Lfield^I:x_{π(i)}=x_i^q\}, \] which includes the Fourier spectra of $\K$-valued functions on finite abelian groups split by $\Lfield$. Our structural starting point is a $\F q$-linear Hamming isometry taking each cycle of $π$ of length $\ell$ to the subfield repetition code $\{(b,\ldots,b):b\in\F{q^\ell}\}$. From this normal form we obtain exact symbol weight and received-word distance enumerators, all list sizes, and…
